title: Lohnt sich das? salary entries, data version 1
description: Response of /api/v1/data.json. Source of truth for the API: the build, the CSV columns, the field table on the website and docs/api.md all derive from or are checked against this file.

schema_version.description: Data version. Bumped (and published under a new /api/vN/ path) only for breaking changes.

generated_at.description: UTC time the site was built.

entry.description: One approved salary entry. At least one of gross_monthly_income_eur and net_monthly_income_eur is set; if both are set, net is not larger than gross.

id.description: Stable 12-character identifier derived from the submission.

video_url.description: https link to the YouTube video the entry is taken from.

profession.description: Profession title: the primary profession or job featured in the video.

gross_monthly_income_eur.description: Gross monthly income in euros; null if not stated.

net_monthly_income_eur.description: Net monthly income in euros; null if not stated.

gross_income_proof_url.description: https link to evidence for the gross income (e.g. video timestamp, payslip page); null if none given.

net_income_proof_url.description: https link to evidence for the net income; null if none given.

approved_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was manually approved for publication.
